headline: Nigeria Commits N450B to Agriculture and Approves N1.5T Bank Recapitalisation
summary: President Bola Tinubu's administration committed N450 billion to agricultural programs and approved N1.5 trillion for banking sector recapitalisation to boost food security and lending.
why: Nigeria is Africa's largest economy. Central policy measures targeted at agricultural output and commercial bank solvency support systemic financial stability and domestic food supply.
why_moved: Government capital injections and bank recapitalisation approvals strengthened confidence in the Nigerian financial sector.
